name: run_program_entry_point
description: Program entry routine that finds the running task and the current directory, opens files, and sets up input and output through library stubs before running its main flow. It calls several local helpers and returns a status word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:0:013C
name: cleanup_library_then_return
description: Calls library functions including a forbid and reply step, with a conditional second cleanup path, then returns the stored parameter. The exact sequence is only partly identifiable from the evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:0:0190
name: invoke_two_function_pointers
description: Calls two functions through pointers at fixed negative offsets from a base register, one after the other, then returns. The library names are not identified, so both calls are indirect dispatches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:0:01A2
name: call_library_with_fallback
description: Calls a library function and returns its result when it is non-zero. Otherwise it runs a fallback sequence of library calls, passes the value 100 to one of them, and returns that value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:2:0000
name: start_tool_with_error_report
description: Checks the startup arguments for a debug option, then looks up a resident tag or the workbench task to start a tool. It prints messages when the tool cannot be found or started, including the error code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:2:0110
name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings character by character. It returns zero when they match, minus one when the first string sorts lower, and one otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:2:0138
name: build_lock_node_chain
description: Walks a list of entries, allocating a cleared 8-byte node for each and storing a duplicated lock from the entry in it. Nodes are chained with pointers stored as addresses divided by four, and the head is returned, or zero if an allocation or duplication fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:5:0000
name: pass_params_to_subroutine
description: Calls another routine, passing a global value, its own parameter, and the address of a stack slot. It returns nothing and only forwards the call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:4:0000
name: measure_stack_buffer_and_forward
description: Calls a function pointer from a global base, then measures the length of a 140-byte stack string up to its null terminator. If the string is non-empty, it passes the buffer and its length to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:LoadWB:4:004C
name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory location addressed by the address register. Nothing else happens and nothing is returned.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_block_entry_routine
description: Boot block entry that increments a counter and, when a flag is set, copies a block of bytes into a buffer before calling a routine. Otherwise it runs a library check that returns minus one on failure.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:bootblock:0:0048
name: boot_entry_with_interrupt_control
description: Shares the opening sequence of the boot block entry: it increments a counter, copies a block when a flag is set, and otherwise runs a library check returning minus one on failure. It also writes the interrupt enable register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:bootblock:0:00A0
name: restore_interrupt_state_after_check
description: Calls a library check and returns minus one on failure. On success it decrements a nesting counter and re-enables interrupts when the counter drops to zero, after clearing a status word and running two helpers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:bootblock:0:00EA
name: install_trackdisk_interrupt_handler
description: Disables interrupts, looks up a device, and swaps in a new interrupt handler while saving the previous one. If the lookup fails, it returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:bootblock:0:015C
name: build_marker_record_and_call
description: Writes a small record containing an illegal-instruction marker, a self pointer and a code entry, then passes it to a library function and stores the result. The library function is not identified from the evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:bootblock:0:01B8
name: service_disk_request_record
description: Checks a request record's state and type fields and, when they match, copies a block of data into the request buffer while reading the disk status port. It then updates the record's state fields to show completion.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:bootblock:0:02CA
